text:
ashley: Heads-up: we just got a customer escalation (large SaaS tenant) — p99 for /v1/chat/generate jumped from ~320ms to ~1.1s for requests with seq_len>1024 after last night's runtime deploy. Seeing errors only on the hosted cluster in us-west2.

mike: Noted. Any correlation with the kernel toggles or compile flags we shipped?

ashley: The deploy included the new attention heuristic and the flashopt compile flag (FLASHOPT_ENABLE=1). Attach: quick perf samples I pulled from metrics: 
- baseline (yesterday): p95=190ms p99=320ms (seq>1024)
- after deploy: p95=420ms p99=1100ms (seq>1024)
- token throughput unchanged on short seqs (<256).

jordan: ops-bot created INC-4321 for tracking. Can you paste the exact runtime config for the failing nodes?

ashley: Config snippet from the canary pool:

```
ATTN_KERNEL_HEURISTIC=flashopt_prefer
FLASHOPT_ENABLE=1
ATTN_FALLBACK=sdpa_fallback
COMPILE_FLAGS="-O3 -march=native -DFLASH_OPT"
```

mike: That heuristic flips long-seq traffic to flashopt kernels. My hunch: for certain seq shapes flashopt is slower due to kernel launch overhead + missed vectorization on our GPU SKU.

lina: We merged PR#753 that adjusted kernel selection thresholds (commit 3f2a9b7). It was tested on perf infra but maybe not our exact hw profile. If this is the cause we should toggle the heuristic for the affected pool while we roll a fix.

jordan: Agreed. Immediate mitigation options: 1) flip ATTN_KERNEL_HEURISTIC back to legacy on the affected node pool (no restart required for heuristic config?); 2) set ATTENTION_KCACHE_LIMIT to force sdpa for seq>512; 3) hotpatch bin to change default kernel priority. Which is lowest risk?

mike: 1) is safest — heuristics read at request-time in our router, so toggling env in config store and reloading router instances will start routing to sdpa fallback without rebuilding models. I'll do that on the canary pool first.

ashley: Repro steps I used locally:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b", "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"x"}], "max_tokens":512, "seq_len":1200}'
```
Then hit the same model pinned to canary. Can reproduce ~1.05s p99 within 5 runs.

mike: I'm toggling the heuristic on the canary pool now to force sdpa_fallback. Patch command: 
```
redwoodctl config set --env canary ATTN_KERNEL_HEURISTIC=legacy_prefer && redwoodctl rollout restart router --pool canary
```
I'll post timing after it finishes.

ops-bot: [INC-4321] Incident created by ops-bot: Latency regression observed in us-west2 canary cluster (p99 spike for long seq). Priority: P1.

mike: Can confirm rollout triggered. Watch metrics for the next 3m.

lina: Also starting a bisect on the compile flags. I suspect the -DFLASH_OPT path for our CUDA kernels behaves worse on A100S microcode version 52. If so we should gate that compile flag by hwmap.

jordan: After 2 minutes: metrics show p99 down to ~360ms on canary. Looks like heuristic toggle worked.

ashley: Customer updated: their tail latency dropped back and they can confirm. Thanks.

mike: Next steps: 1) keep heuristic flip in canary for 1h and then schedule a staged rollout to prod with traffic shaping; 2) lina to finish compile-flag bisect and submit a hotfix to kernel selector to prefer sdpa on our affected GPU microcodes; 3) add a safety check to the heuristic to avoid switching heavy long-seq chat traffic to flashopt unless microcode/hw profile matches known-good list.

lina: I'll open a follow-up PR and tag @mike for review. I'll include exact repro and perf logs.

ashley: Logging closure notes: toggled back heuristic -> mitigation. Incident INC-4321 will be updated with cause = kernel-selection regression due to flashopt compile flag + heuristic threshold. Assigning to eng-runtime to own the fix.

mike: Also adding an alert tweak to detect sudden p99 x3 increase for seq>512 so we auto-flag kernel heuristic rollouts next time.

sre-oncall: Marking DONE for P1 triage; keep incident open until rollout fix merged + prod validation.
